meta.title: DSH Danbooru tools
meta.description: DSH bundle made by an AI agent (designed, implemented and verified by AI) — read-only, image-only Danbooru tools (video posts are filtered out automatically): post and tag search (year, rating, Hot/score order), tag details with wiki excerpts, related tags; artist discovery by a whole year's total favorites (default 5% body-shape tag gate; optional skin color / skin texture appearance references and overall color-tone references with per-tag ratios), a Hot / favorite-growth / fallback weighted sampler, similar artists (tag profile + facial-expression profile re-ranked by expression-tag cosine; furry themes and 3D renders downweighted), image-to-artist search (the agent groups tags from the image; layered priority person → expression → rendering technique → lineart → clothing texture → color → lighting → tags, with technique/lineart/clothing/color/lighting first in style mode; up to four tags per group all searched; candidates are penalized by their 3D share, and near-duplicate variants are clustered by parent_id/md5 before counting), and body-part specialists (ranks artists by favorites of part-focus-tag posts, preferring 2D drawings over 3D). Examples prefer posts that carry the requested tags and show the face; allow_no_face=true permits back views, silhouettes and other face-hidden compositions. Saved credentials lift the tag limit. R18 is included by default; pass rating=g for general only. Note: this is a DSH bundle, not a standalone program.
